chunks: Sa'd, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn, from Ja'far ibn Bashīr, from Dharīḥ al-Muḥāribī, who said:
Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said to me: “Perform the Jumu'ah prayer with the adhan of these people, for they are the most steadfast of people in observing the time.”

key_terms.بِأَذَانِ: by means of the call to prayer

ai.seo_question: Can one perform Jumu'ah prayer based on the adhan of others if they are careful about prayer times?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys a legal instruction regarding the Jumu'ah prayer and reliance on the adhan being called by others because of their careful observance of the proper prayer time. It highlights the importance of precision in the timing of acts of worship, especially salat.
